Revision (examiner audit, 2026-09-05): the card's notes ask for 'other aquatic animals', which the boxed line stops short of, so step 2's WHY now gives the fuller wording; the printed line is correct as far as it goes and was left alone, and whether the phrase is required is a question for a board teacher.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: It is named as an occupation because it covers the whole chain from catching to selling.
common_mistakes: Leaving out shell fish and other aquatic animals.
steps.margin_note: One sentence, but list all four activities.
lines: Fishery is an occupation, or industry, for

steps.label: What it covers
steps.why: Prawns, crabs and molluscs are the other aquatic animals the industry covers, so the fullest definition names fish, shell fish and other aquatic animals.
steps.memory_tip: Fish, shell fish and other aquatic animals.
steps.margin_note: Close with what it is all for.

lines.text: fish or shell fish for human consumption

insider_note: Fishery covers more than fish — shell fish and other aquatic animals count too. Say so and the definition is complete.
